ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account flag warranted — driver did not press "I'm Here" and was never near the pickup.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he was 'on my way' does not support a no-show fee: he never pressed 'I'm Here', never entered the pickup radius, and the rider cancelled within the 3-minute free-cancellation window (NS-4); system GPS records override his statement.
